title: stanleya confertiflora
intro: Stanleya confertiflora, commonly known as Towering Mountain Blazing Star or Towering Mountain Blazing Star, is a perennial plant native to the western United States and Canada. It is known for its bright yellow flowers and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to promote relaxation and reduce stress, while its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, have been shown to exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. Additionally, Stanleya confertiflora has been used to treat skin conditions and wounds due to its antimicrobial and antifungal properties.
